liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer was somewhat disappointed by the Jack Straw [12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer found the China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider excellent [12]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The Dark Star into Eyes of the World sequence is singled out as the show's highlight [9]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: You Ain't Woman Enough [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-02-15.sbd.hall.1580.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 203 min; rated 4.62/5 by 21 [1]
- **gd1973-02-15.150175.sbd-fixed.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 30 songs; 203 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd73-02-15.sbd.hall.1580.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 203 min; rated 4.52/5 by 200 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the recording as very crisp; Reviewer rates sound four stars: slight hiss and limited analog warmth, possibly from azimuth issues during transfer [11][15]
- **gd1973-02-15.124360.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 208 min; rated 4.62/5 by 13 [4]

## Around the show

- CD1 track 1 holds Jack Straw and Box of Rain from the soundcheck [1]
- The recording includes a soundcheck of Jack Straw and Box of Rain [3]
- Reviewer calls this show a standout in a standout year for the band [10]
- Reviewer sees this show as a prime example of what 1973 was about [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-02-15.sbd.hall.1580.shnf**: transferred by Mike Hall; source: MR > D Latvala Reels @ 3 3/4 ips > DBX Reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM > DAT > CD [1]
- **gd1973-02-15.150175.sbd-fixed.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 20, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) [2]. Also: Beat It On Down The Line comes from an audience mono cassette master source, patching the soundboard; Jerry Moore supplied the original source and removed all tunings; China Cat Sunflower track mark was fixed [2]
- **gd73-02-15.sbd.hall.1580.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer got the DATs from Dougal about three years earlier, after requesting the best available copy of this show; Reviewer's first-generation tape, given by a stepsister, held only the first set; Chain: master reel, Latvala reels at 3 3/4 ips, DBX reels at 7 1/2 ips, PCM, DAT, CD [3][14][17]
- **gd1973-02-15.124360.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by dusborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:1580): MR > D Latvala Reels @ 3 3/4 ips > DBX Reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM > DAT > CD and Audience (shnid:124195):… [4]. Also: Dick Latvala shared copies of the master reels; Mike Hall provided the soundboard [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, Madison, WI, 2-15-1973 (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/06/grateful-dead-madison-wi-2-15-1973-sbd.html) [22]
- Poster by Bob Morris Grateful Dead: [1973-02-15 Dane County Coliseum, Madison, WI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-02-15-dane-county-coliseum-madison-wi-usa/) [23]
- Poster by gravitystereo: [Grateful Dead - Cosmic Death ( Flashback ) ( Dane County Coliseum, Madison, Wisconsin, USA, February 15th, 1973 ) - grav](https://gravitystereo.com/product/grateful-dead-cosmic-death-flashback-dane-county-coliseum-madison-wisconsin-usa-february-15th-1973/) [24]
- Poster by Mason's Children: [February Grateful Dead Show Listening Guides](https://www.gratefuldeadbook.com/post/february-grateful-dead-show-listening-guides) [25]
